purpose: Repair G4B's bootstrap-power failure by adding exactly two prospectively fixed training seeds at every eta of all four registered 1.7B combined-grid curves.
prospective_scope: G4B and all 66 v4+v4b endpoint losses are disclosed. No v4c result root, launch manifest, attempt directory, GPU process, endpoint loss, or G4C calculation exists at registration. G4B selects only the seed-power repair and does not select among v4c outcomes.

g4b_disclosure.trigger_rule: Because all four point fits are INTERIOR and both point estimates are inside the registered bands, while only 7067/10000 shared bootstrap refits are valid, add statistical power by completing the same combined grids at two new fixed seeds. No eta is added, removed, moved, narrowed, or recentered.

seed_power_design.cell_identity: 22 registered combined-grid etas x 2 added seeds = 44 new cells
seed_power_design.no_grid_change_rule: After registration, no eta, curve, seed, cell, endpoint, or fit rule may be added, removed, shifted, substituted, narrowed, or recentered.

common_protocol.inheritance: Every scientific setting, materialized input, model revision, evaluator, evidence rule, and command option is inherited byte-for-byte from v4/v4b except seed, result root, cell identity, assignment, and attempt path.
common_protocol.primary_outcome: finite fixed-development evaluation NLL per trained token
common_protocol.input_binding: Reuse the complete hash-bound v4 materialized input ledger. As in v4/v4b, the raw expanded training pool is fixed and the training seed is seed||seed; no outcome-dependent data construction occurs.

frozen_analysis.input_evidence: Load all 48 valid v4 cells, all 18 valid v4b cells, and all 44 valid v4c cells. Attempt 2, if present under registered loss-blind whole-curve authority, replaces attempt 1. Missing, invalid, overlapping, or hash-mismatched evidence makes G4C NOT_EVALUABLE.
frozen_analysis.curve_model: For each curve fit loss=a*x^2+b*x+c by ordinary least squares to the five-seed mean at each registered combined-grid eta, where x=log2(eta).
frozen_analysis.interior_rule: a>0 and min(grid)+1e-12 < -b/(2a) < max(grid)-1e-12 in log2 eta. Nonpositive curvature, boundary, or outside vertices are UNBRACKETED.

bootstrap.pairing: One common five-index draw with replacement is applied to every eta and all four curve refits.
bootstrap.threshold_scaling: The G4B 95% bootstrap-validity requirement remains exactly 95%; with 10000 registered replicates this is 9500 valid all-four refits.
bootstrap.invalid_draw: A draw is invalid if any of the four curve vertices is not interior or either D is nonpositive.
bootstrap.D_intervals: Equal-tailed percentile 95% intervals in log2 D, exponentiated for reported D-scale endpoints.
bootstrap.monotone_interval: Equal-tailed percentile 95% CI over the same all-four-valid paired draws.

evaluable_requirements: all 48 v4 cells, all 18 v4b cells, and all 44 v4c cells have valid hash-bound COMPLETED evidence
all four five-seed combined-grid quadratic optima are INTERIOR
at least 9500 of 10000 shared paired-bootstrap all-four refits are valid
pass_conditions_all_required: the paired 95% bootstrap CI for log2 D(T=5)-log2 D(T=20) has lower endpoint > 0
gate_G4C.failure_rule: Complete evaluable five-seed evidence that violates any pass condition is FAIL.
gate_G4C.not_evaluable_rule: Any failed evaluability requirement is NOT_EVALUABLE.

frozen_dependency.use: evidence loading, quadratic arithmetic, quantiles, hashing, and atomic JSON output only

frozen_analyzer.freeze_event: These raw hashes are recorded before the registration commit, push, launch-manifest construction, authority, result-root creation, or any v4c GPU work.

launch_machinery.execution_commit_rule: Both nodes execute at the clean pushed registration commit in isolated /root/yeto-v4c checkouts. Running /root/yeto-v5b and frozen /root/yeto checkouts are untouched.

fleet_coordination.observed_at_registration: v4b is complete; GPUs 0-5 are idle on both nodes; v5b owns GPUs 6-7 on both nodes; v6 is sealed and waiting for the fleet.
fleet_coordination.initial_claim: After fresh proofs, v4c claims GPUs 0-5 on both nodes and launches twelve longest-first queues alongside v5b. It never stops, changes, or overlaps v5b.
fleet_coordination.deferred_claim: GPUs 6-7 receive no v4c process while any v5b controller or compute process remains. After v5b fully drains, fresh per-node proofs authorize four deferred v4c queues.
fleet_coordination.assignment: Each initial queue begins with an S10240 cell. Eight initial queues have two S10240 cells; four initial queues have one S10240 then four S2560 cells. Each deferred queue has one S10240 then one S2560 cell. Thus all 24 long cells precede short cells within every queue, all 44 cells are balanced 22 per node, and estimated makespan accounts for the v5b delay.
fleet_coordination.v6_handoff_note: After v4c claims its initial slots, append a claim line to /private/tmp/h200-factorial-note.md. After all v4c work and G4C analysis complete, append the exact marker V4C DONE so v6 may start.

evidence_contract.inheritance: The v4 validator requirements apply unchanged: exact command hash and source commit, immutable attempt records, complete learner and strict-quorum steps, tape and rho telemetry rows, finite 1024-row endpoint evaluation, clean git evidence, and artifact hashes.

retry_contract.unit: every registered eta for one T-by-mu-by-added-seed curve (four cells for S2560/mu0; six cells otherwise)
retry_contract.forbidden: No retry for finite unfavorable loss, an edge optimum, scientific divergence, bootstrap validity, or any outcome-dependent reason. Attempt 2 replaces attempt 1 for every cell in an authorized whole-curve group.

wall_clock.start_event: immutable v4c launch authority creation immediately before initial GPUs 0-5 queues launch
wall_clock.stop_rule: At the deadline, controllers terminate only recorded v4c scientific process groups and seal remaining registered cells as NOT_RUN_WALL_CEILING.

storage.prior_result_rule: v4, v4b, v5b, v6 preparation, and every earlier result tree are read-only and never modified, moved, deleted, or reused. Cross-node analysis mirrors live only inside the new v4c tree.

operational_rails.cloud: No GCP or AWS resources or commands.
operational_rails.process_control: Normal termination targets recorded process groups. Wildcard pkill is forbidden; bracketed process matching is used only for read-only checks.
operational_rails.git: Registration commit and push originate from the Mac clone. Nodes receive isolated clean exact-commit checkouts only after the push.
operational_rails.registration_order: Commit and push the JSON, Markdown, frozen analyzer, and hash-bound launch machinery before creating a v4c result root, manifest, authority, attempt directory, or GPU process.
operational_rails.prior_results: G4B, v4, and v4b are immutable read-only analysis inputs; v5b is an untouched concurrent lane; v6 remains unlaunched until V4C DONE.
